name: grid-subgrid-fragment-inherited-rows
derivation: The subgrid spans the parent's23px and31px rows, with one local47px column. The first frame holds exactly the first row. Indivisible row items require the next row on the second frame; the inherited row allocation must continue, not restart at23px. Root and subgrid each publish23px and31px fragments. Rectangles are world coordinates at frame origins(5,7) and(11,43), unlike parent-relative source x/y. This uses the existing minimal-distortion fragmentation policy; Grid2 section13 does not uniquely prescribe every fragmented layout.
